## Phase 3: Risk Management Improvements — Implementation Plan

### Overview
4 Coder tasks created to address Issues #16, #26, #28, #30, #34, #36 from wealth-optimization-analysis.

### Task Summary

| Task | Files Modified | Issue(s) | Key Changes |
|------|---------------|----------|-------------|
| Config defaults fix | config/settings.py | #16, #34, #36 | STALE_POSITION_HOURS: 24→10, DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT_PCT: 0.20→0.08, STOP_LOSS_PCT: 0.03→0.045 |
| Adaptive position sizing | risk_mgr.py, position_mgr.py | #28 | New get_win_rate_multiplier() queries last 20 trades; <40% win→0.5x, >60%→1.25x |
| Profit lock after target | main.py | #30 | _profit_locked flag; when daily_pl >= target → 50% size + 1.5% stops; 90% hysteresis |
| Earnings calendar filter | NEW earnings_filter.py, main.py | #26 | yfinance calendar check; cache 1h TTL; 75% size reduction for earnings today/tomorrow |

### Design Decisions
- **Fail-open everywhere**: All new checks (win rate, earnings) return safe defaults on failure
- **No schema changes**: Win rate uses existing trades table; earnings is in-memory cache
- **Hysteresis on profit lock**: Deactivates at 90% of target to prevent flapping
- **Config values remain live-editable**: All changed defaults can still be overridden via config_overrides DB table
- **Multiplier stacking**: Win rate multiplier compounds with score-based and ATR-based multipliers in get_position_size()

### Dependencies
- These tasks can run in parallel (no inter-task dependencies)
- No dependency on Phase 1 or Phase 2 tasks (different files/methods)
- Earnings filter creates a new file (no merge conflicts)
